name: First and South
reviewNotes:
Added automatically from Gene Casey & the Lone Sharks - show calendar. Check the name and address; research the dance floor.

Directory research 2026-10-04: Hours differ on the restaurant's own site: the weekly 'What's happening' page (used here) says Mon 3-9, Tue 12-9, Thu-Sat 12-10, Sun brunch 10-3, closed Wed, while the page's structured data says Mon/Tue/Thu/Fri 12-9, Sat 11-9, Sun 10-3. Please confirm. The site also links a personal LinkedIn profile (not recorded). No usable venue photos: the site shows only food and drink close-ups and a text-heavy chalk mural, no room, bar or stage views. No dance floor is mentioned; music is a dinner set by rotating musicians.
hours: Mon 3 PM-9 PM; Tue 12 PM-9 PM; Thu-Sat 12 PM-10 PM; Sun brunch 10 AM-3 PM; closed Wed
description: A bar and restaurant in Greenport village serving local North Fork food and drinks, with live music on Tuesday evenings (6-9 PM) and on the first Friday of each month.
